legal.privacySubtitle: Last updated September 2026. Plain-language version below — the short of it: your budget is yours, and it stays that way.
legal.termsSubtitle: Last updated September 2026. These terms cover how you can use SmartJib, and what you can expect from us.
legal.authoritativeNotice: Note: The English version of this document is the legally authoritative version.

privacy.s1Body: We collect the information you give us directly: your email address, the income, expenses, receipt attachments, categories and goals you enter, and account preferences such as currency, language and display settings. The app also keeps authentication state and working copies in browser storage for sign-in, offline use and pending synchronization. We do not ask for bank logins, card numbers, or account numbers.
privacy.s2Body: Your budgeting data is used to power the app itself — to show your balances, calculate your budget, and sync your information across your devices. We do not use your financial data to build advertising profiles, and we do not sell it to third parties.
privacy.s3Body: Your personal workspace is accessible only to your account. A Household workspace is shared only with active members according to their Rules-enforced roles. We use Firebase for authentication, database hosting and optional analytics; our hosting provider to serve the app; Resend to deliver invitations and contact messages; and Open Food Facts when you request a barcode lookup. Each processor receives only the data needed for that operation. We do not sell your data.
privacy.s4Body: Optional analytics is off until you agree. If enabled, SmartJib records limited product-usage events and page paths. A strict allowlist removes financial amounts, balances, categories, receipt data, contact text and other free-form financial content before an event can leave the app. You can withdraw consent from Profile settings.
privacy.s5Body: We keep your workspace data while your account is active. When you request deletion, SmartJib removes the data it can verify and reports any incomplete step instead of claiming success. Household data is deleted by its owner; other members can leave without deleting household-owned data. Delivery, security and hosting providers may retain limited operational logs under their own retention policies. The app also keeps a copy of your recent budgeting data on your device so it can work offline; that local copy is removed when you sign out.
privacy.s6Body: You can export your budgeting history as CSV or a complete, restorable JSON backup from Profile at any time. You can also delete your data or account from Profile; destructive actions report partial failures and remain retryable.
privacy.s7Body: If we make meaningful changes to how we handle your data, we'll let you know in the app before the changes take effect.
privacy.s8Body: Questions about this policy or your data? Reach out any time from our Contact page.

terms.s1Body: By creating an account, you agree to use SmartJib for its intended purpose — tracking your personal budget. You're responsible for keeping your login details secure and for the accuracy of the information you enter.
terms.s2Body: You must be able to legally enter into these terms to use SmartJib. Personal workspaces are private to their account owner; Household workspaces can be shared with members you invite, according to the role you assign.
terms.s3Body: SmartJib’s core features are free with no time limit. Each eligible account may start one 90-day Pro trial without a payment card. Billing is not currently enabled, the trial does not renew automatically, and SmartJib will not charge you. If paid plans launch later, pricing and billing terms will be shown for your explicit agreement before any payment.
terms.s4Body: SmartJib is a budgeting and tracking tool. It is not a bank, does not move real money on your behalf, and does not provide financial, investment, or tax advice. Decisions about your finances remain entirely your own.
terms.s5Body: Please don't use SmartJib to store information that isn't yours, to attempt to access other users' accounts, or to interfere with the normal operation of the app.
terms.s6Body: There is currently no paid subscription to cancel. You can leave or delete a Household workspace according to your role, export your data, or delete your account from Profile. If an erasure cannot be completed, SmartJib keeps the account available and reports the remaining steps so you can retry.
terms.s7Body: We may add, change, or remove features over time as SmartJib improves. We'll do our best to communicate meaningful changes in advance.
terms.s8Body: SmartJib is provided "as is." While we work hard to keep your data accurate and available, we can't guarantee the service will be uninterrupted or error-free, and we aren't liable for financial decisions made using the app.
terms.s9Body: Questions about these terms? Reach out from our Contact page.

whatIsFlousy.title: What is SmartJib? The Free Budgeting App
whatIsFlousy.description: SmartJib is a private budget tracker that separates what money is for—needs, wants, and savings—from where money is held—bank, home, or wallet. It supports 12 currencies and 4 budgeting strategies: 50/30/20, zero-based budgeting, envelope budgeting, and pay-yourself-first. SmartJib does not connect to your bank; you enter transactions manually. Account data is cached locally and synced to Firebase when you sign in.

items.question: Is SmartJib free?
items.answer: SmartJib’s core budget is free with no time limit. Eligible accounts can start one 90-day Pro trial without a card; it does not renew automatically, and billing is not currently enabled.

items.question: Does SmartJib connect to my bank?
items.answer: No, SmartJib does not connect to your bank. You manually enter transactions for privacy and control.

items.question: What currencies does SmartJib support?
items.answer: SmartJib supports 12 currencies: MAD, EUR, USD, GBP, CAD, CHF, AED, SAR, EGP, TND, DZD, and XOF.

items.question: Is my data private?
items.answer: Yes. Account data is cached locally and synced to Firebase when you sign in. We do not use your financial data to build advertising profiles or sell it to third parties. See our Privacy Policy for details.

items.question: What budgeting methods does SmartJib support?
items.answer: SmartJib supports 4 budgeting strategies: 50/30/20, zero-based budgeting, envelope budgeting, and pay-yourself-first.

items.question: Can I export my data?
items.answer: Yes. From Profile you can export CSV files or a complete, restorable JSON backup.

items.question: How do I delete my account?
items.answer: You can permanently delete your account and its associated budgeting data from Profile. SmartJib reports any incomplete deletion step so you can retry.

about.title: Money you can finally make sense of.
about.subtitle: SmartJib started from a simple frustration: budgeting apps that tell you what you spent, but never help you understand why your money still runs out.
about.s1Body: Every budgeting question really comes down to two things: what is this money for, and where does it actually sit right now? Most apps mix the two together until neither makes sense. SmartJib keeps them separate, so you always know both — without spreadsheets, without guesswork.
about.s2Body: We designed SmartJib for real budgets — the cash in your wallet, the money sitting at home, and whatever's left in the bank. No bank connections required, no complicated setup. Just add your income, pick a style that fits how you think about money, and start logging as you go.
about.s3Title: Free to start, honest about the rest
about.s3Body: At launch, SmartJib’s core tracking, budgeting styles and savings goals are free with no time limit. Eligible accounts can also try Pro once for 90 days without a card.
about.s4Body: Budgeting means sharing personal details about your life. We take that seriously: personal workspaces stay private to their owner, Household workspaces are shared only with active members, your data is never sold, and you can export or delete it.

help.title: Questions, answered.
help.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out and we'll get back to you.

faqs.question: Do I need to connect my bank account?
faqs.answer: No. SmartJib never asks for your bank login, card number, or account number. You add your income and expenses yourself, and choose which place — bank, home, or wallet — each one belongs to.

faqs.question: How does SmartJib decide my budget?
faqs.answer: You pick a budgeting style that fits how you think about money. SmartJib then splits your income into needs, wants, and savings automatically. You can switch styles at any time, and your categories adjust to match.

faqs.question: What's the difference between 'what it's for' and 'where it is'?
faqs.answer: Your budget decides what your money is for — rent is a need, dinner out is a want. Separately, SmartJib tracks where that money actually sits — in your bank, at home, or in your wallet. Keeping these separate means your numbers always make sense.

faqs.question: Can I use more than one currency?
faqs.answer: Yes. SmartJib supports 12 currencies. Change the display currency from Profile → Preferences; historical months keep their saved currency.

faqs.question: What happens if I delete an expense by mistake?
faqs.answer: When an expense deletion succeeds, SmartJib reverses its effect on the relevant balances. If synchronization fails, the app reports the problem instead of claiming the deletion completed.

faqs.question: What do I get with SmartJib Pro?
faqs.answer: Pro adds barcode-assisted course entry, multi-month trends, income-source management, bulk CSV import, category caps and rollover, and Household collaboration. Pro is included free for your first 90 days.

faqs.question: Can I export my data?
faqs.answer: Yes. From Profile you can export CSV files or a complete, restorable JSON backup.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account?
faqs.answer: You can permanently delete your account and its associated budgeting data from Profile. SmartJib reports any incomplete deletion step so you can retry.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: Last updated September 2026. A short, honest explanation of the browser storage SmartJib uses.

sections.title: 1. Browser storage we use
sections.body: SmartJib uses cookies, localStorage and IndexedDB to keep you signed in, remember language/theme and workspace choices, cache budget data for fast and offline use, and hold pending edits until they safely synchronize.

sections.title: 2. Essential storage
sections.body: Authentication state, security/session data, preferences, offline cache and the finance outbox are required for the service you request. Blocking or clearing them may sign you out, reset preferences, or remove device-only demo and unsynchronized data.

sections.title: 3. Optional analytics
sections.body: Firebase Analytics and any configured analytics provider stay unloaded and send nothing unless you explicitly agree. When enabled, only allowlisted product-usage dimensions are sent; financial amounts and free-form budget content are blocked.

sections.title: 4. No advertising cookies
sections.body: SmartJib does not use advertising cookies, cross-site tracking, or sell profiles. Analytics consent is separate from the storage needed to run your budget.

sections.title: 5. Managing your choice
sections.body: You can grant or withdraw analytics consent in Profile settings and clear browser storage through your browser. Withdrawing analytics consent stops future analytics events; blocking essential storage may prevent SmartJib from working or synchronizing correctly.

sync.conflictDetail: A newer cloud change overlaps your local edit. Discard the local copy only if you want to keep the cloud version.
sync.queuedLocally: Your changes are safely queued on this device.
sync.blockedEntitlement: Editing the shared household budget needs an active Pro entitlement. Your change stays safely queued on this device and will sync once access is active again.
sync.sponsorRebound: Shared budget access restored — this household now runs on your Pro plan, and your queued changes are being sent.
sync.sponsorLapsed: This household runs on another account's Pro plan and that plan is no longer active. Everything stays readable; editing resumes once the plan is renewed.
sync.sponsorUnreadable: This household's shared budget is paid for by another account, which this device cannot inspect. Only the household owner can change whose plan it runs on.
sync.accessRestored: Restored your access to this workspace. Changes that were queued while it was refused are sending now.
sync.membershipBlocked: Your membership in this workspace is recorded as inactive, and the rules published here let only a workspace owner change that. Ask an owner to invite you again.
sync.rulesBehind: The rules published on this project cannot store a household plan owner, so they refuse the write. Redeploy them from the version of firestore.rules this build ships with (firebase deploy --only firestore:rules).
sync.profileInvalid: This account's plan is stored in a form the app cannot verify (an unrecognised plan or status value), so the server will not attach the household to it. Correct the plan fields on the user profile in the Firebase console, or start the Pro trial from the app.
sync.restoreAccessHint: Writes here are refused because the Pro plan that pays for this household belongs to another account. You own this household and hold an active plan, so it can be switched to yours.
sync.restoreAccessDone: Household plan owner updated. Your queued changes go out on the next sync.
sync.restoreAccessConsistent: This household already runs on your plan, so the refusal came from somewhere else.
sync.restoreAccessFailed: The server refused the change, so this household's plan owner could not be updated.
